text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=gpu-infer-west2 - HIGH GPU_VMEM_PRESSURE (threshold=85%)
pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026 created and routed to oncall
maria: acked. I'm on it. pulling metrics now.
maria: quick summary from alert: cuda_alloc_fail rate spike + evictions increasing, per-gpu vmem at ~92% on pool gpu-west2a
liam: saw the same on dashboards, some jobs showing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in logs
jason: tagging customers impacted: two API customers showing 5xxs, internal perf tests failing. Estimated RPS drop ~12% on that shard
maria: running `kubectl -n infer logs deploy/gpu-infer-worker --since=10m | grep -E "alloc|OOM|CUDA" -m 50`
maria: logs: "E cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory" repeated, and `kvcache` evictions ramping
sre-ops: checking node health: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv` shows 11234 MiB / 12288 MiB on gpu-3
liam: any recent model rollouts? could be a larger context length run started by a dedicated job
jason: rollout looks green, no canary for large model. But there was a midnight batch job scheduled by analytics touching same pool
maria: mitigation plan: 1) pause analytics batch (if running) 2) drain one node from pool to stop new allocations 3) enable fallback to smaller-model variant for hostnames matching affected customers
maria: pausing job: `kubectl -n batch scale job/analytics-ctxt 0` -> success
sre-ops: draining node gpu-west2a-node-7: `kubectl drain gpu-west2a-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (starting)
liam: creating temporary routing rule to steer new requests to dedicated fallback pool: `route set-model-preference --service gpu-infer-west2 --fallback small-v2`
jason: customer comm: pinging CS to notify two customer accounts that we are mitigating (low-level outage) :email:
maria: node drain completed, redispatched pods; memory use on remaining GPUs still high but allocation failure rate dropped by ~40%
sre-ops: increased autoscale on dedicated pool by +2 nodes to relieve pressure; provisioning in progress
maria: temporary config tweak: lowered per-request max context from 4096 -> 2048 for affected route to reduce KV cache pressure
jason: monitoring error-rate and latency, will report if <5% errors in 10m window
liam: observed one pod restart with `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` at 3619998950, restarted and recovered
maria: paging update: alert suppressed via autoplace after mitigations, but keeping pager acknowledged until stable for 30m :white_check_mark:
sre-ops: autoscale nodes ready, aggregate GPU vmem at ~68% now, no new alloc fails in last 2m
jason: CS notified customers with ETA ~20m to full recovery. They acknowledged and appreciate the quick update
maria: creating incident ticket and scheduling postmortem tomorrow 10:00am PT. Suspect batch job + high-context inference combined to exhaust cache. Follow-ups: consider autoscale floor change and preemptive routing for large-batch jobs
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026 status -> mitigated (partial); owner=maria; followup=postmortem scheduled
maria: resolving my pager. leaving the thread for handoff to SRE ops for follow-up cleanup.
liam: thanks all. will watch for regression. :thumbsup:
jason: closing oncall thread, leaving final checks to SRE.
sre-ops: noted. I'll keep the runbook open and mark resolved after 30m steady state.
